title: Class Catalogue
description: The real, complete SF2E class catalogue (6 entries), extracted live from gamesystems/sf2e/packs/classes for the induction terminal's Page 4 (design/induction-terminal.md). Class features, feats and spells are deliberately not captured here -- deferred to the real character sheet, same reasoning as ancestry feat/heritage and background feat. Singleton file: data/campaign/class-catalogue.json.

hp.description: HP gained per level from this class -- tools/character-builder/derive.mjs's deriveHP input, added to ancestry HP + the Con modifier each level.

keyAbility.description: One boost slot (core/boost-slots.mjs shape): a single-ability entry is fixed (e.g. Soldier: Constitution only); a multi-ability entry is a real free choice (Witchwarper: Charisma or Intelligence).

trainedSkills.description: Informational only, not resolved as a player choice here -- the `additional` count is a real 'choose N of 18' pick this form doesn't build (design doc §1's 'basic but viable' scope), same deferral already applied to background's own skill grants.

fixed.description: Skill slugs always trained by this class, e.g. ["intimidation"]. Empty is real (several classes fix none).

additional.description: How many more skills of the player's choice this class grants, on top of `fixed`.

attacks.description: Weapon proficiency ranks at level 1, informational only.

otherName.description: A class-specific weapon-group name with its own proficiency (e.g. Operative's 'Simple Guns, Martial Guns'), or null.

defenses.description: Armor proficiency ranks at level 1, informational only.

description.description: Real Player Core flavor text, HTML-stripped, @UUID inline-links resolved to their label text.

choices.description: The genuine choices this class's rules ask (Envoy: trained in Deception, Diplomacy or Intimidation), which the terminal asks on Page 4 and writes into the Item before it is embedded. Written by tools/character-builder/extract-rule-choices.mjs from the real pack; the file is hand-formatted, so for it that tool prints the field to add rather than rewriting the file.
